notes.text: Saul was a monarch of ancient Israel and Judah and, according to the Hebrew Bible and Old Testament, the first king of the United Monarchy.
Saul's reign, traditionally placed in the late eleventh century BC, marked the transition of the Israelites from a scattered tribal society ruled by various judges to organized statehood.
Saul is remembered as a religious figure connected with Israel.
Saul's recorded life dates place this profile around -1079--1010.
Saul is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
